fields.topic: Actual end moments and joint stresses
fields.finding: The fold uses actual FE end moments and correlated axial/bending/torsional demands. It does not add the older dimensional joint proxy. Each design has 1500 end interfaces, with source joints sized to the target and no extra scalar reserve.
fields.remaining: Joint rotational stiffness, local contact, SiC end damage, adhesive peel, shear-induced principal tension, hoop stress and residual stress still require resolved fields and qualification.

qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
